description.zh: DataSourceId和JdbcConnectionString必须指定一项作为输入，否则报错。如果上述2个参数均指定，则优先使用JdbcConnectionString入参。
description.en: Either DataSourceId or JdbcConnectionString must be specified as input, otherwise an error will occur. If both parameters are specified, JdbcConnectionString will be used preferentially.
The ID of the region where the instance is located.

title.zh: 检查JDBC连接串网络连通性

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb check-jdbc-source-net-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxx --jdbc-connection-string jdbc:mysql://rm-xxx.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com:3306/testadmin --data-source-id 123 --region cn-hangzhou
